mentions.name: Networks by Analogy
mentions.description: A book about computer networking that deliberately takes a non protocol-first approach, explaining the shape of the system through analogies and mental models first and then mapping those models back onto the real machinery.
mentions.source_excerpt:
The first is Networks by Analogy: https://networksbyanalogy.com

It’s a book about computer networking, but deliberately not protocol-first. I’m trying to explain the shape of the system using analogies and mental models first, then map those back onto the real machinery.
